284438072.description:
Vintage Estate Tobacco Pipes
Briar Smoking Pipe Collection
9 Items, Mid to Late 20th Century
This estate lot includes nine vintage briar tobacco smoking pipes presenting a diverse selection of classic English and American shapes, finishes, and makers. The collection features smooth, carved, rusticated, and sandblast bowls across various traditional silhouettes including straight billiards, bent apples, bulldogs, and unique carved freehand forms.
ITEMS INCLUDED:
1.
Shamrock Briar Pipe
- Stamped "SHAMROCK" on shank with banded ferrule and P-lip style vulcanite stem
2.
The Tinder Box Carved Bent Pipe
- Stamped "THE TINDER BOX" with rusticated and carved bowl styling
3.
Golden Grain Bulldog Pipe
- Stamped "GOLDEN GRAIN" on shank, smooth finish with accent ring
4.
Senator Bent Apple Pipe
- Stamped "SENATOR" on shank, smooth walnut-tone briar with curved stem
5.
Golden Square London Made Pipe
- Stamped "GOLDEN SQUARE LONDON MADE" on shank with stem logo
6.
Hand Tooled Rhodesian Pipe
- Stamped "HAND TOOLED" on shank, smooth finish with double rim grooving
7.
Carved Fluted Panel Pipe
- Freehand style with deep carved vertical fluting and black stem
8.
Scot Rusticated Billiard Pipe
- Dark sandblast/rusticated finish, stem stamped "SCOT"
9.
Scotsman's Delight Billiard Pipe
- Black rusticated bowl stamped "SCOTSMAN'S DELIGHT MADE IN ENGLAND"
Condition:
Pre-owned vintage estate condition. Bowls show carbon cake and charring consistent with prior use. Stems exhibit varying degrees of oxidation, tooth chatter, and cosmetic wear. All tenons and stems fit securely into shanks with no breaks visible.

Natural Polished Agate Geode Slice with Crystalline Druzy Pocket Gray White
Natural polished agate geode slice specimen in 2 halves featuring gray and white banded patterns with a small crystalline druzy pocket in the upper center. The piece has a natural, unpolished brown/tan outer rind and a smooth, glossy polished cut face revealing concentric agate banding in shades of gray, lavender, and white. Includes views from multiple angles including a split view showing the two halves. This is a raw mineral/rock specimen suitable for display, collecting, or crafting. Condition is natural/as-found with no artificial alterations beyond cutting and polishing. No brand or manufacturer as this is a natural stone specimen. Perfect for collectors, offices, or as a starter set for crystal enthusiasts, these pieces offer both visual impact and versatile functionality in any room.
